performance_observations.claim: finite local sample only; no SLA or fastest claim

first_failures_and_fixes: Increment 1 review found selected runs could record activity before binding; append and streamed repair now enforce binding-before-activity while preserving atomic bound batches.
Increment 1 review found catalog heads ahead of canonical history returned unchanged; they now fail storage.integrity.
Increment 2 review found every process interruption was rejected; a missing RunResult is now allowed only for process-interrupted runs whose every started turn is a complete closed exchange.
The conversation example first failed to compile because three PathBuf arguments were borrowed; only the example call sites were corrected.
Final coverage tracing found no separate-process explicit continuation test; P1B2-11 now uses two isolated child processes and an explicit stdin barrier.
The first P1B2-11 delegate exhausted its run budget after writing partial test changes; inspection, focused execution and three reviews confirmed the recovered changes.

Final review found normally terminal history could omit ToolExecutionFinished after a committed result; reconstruction now permits that omission only when an open turn closes through ProcessRestart, and focused policy/process tests cover both directions.
Final review found two trailing-space Markdown hard breaks after the earlier whitespace scan; they were removed and the corrected all-untracked scan found zero matches.
limitations: Local verification ran only on Linux x86_64. Hosted Ubuntu, macOS and Windows CI was not authorized or run.
No physical power-loss test was performed; process-exit and transaction fault injection cover bounded crash cases.
No live provider request, real credential read, authentication command, private profile or private skill access occurred.
Legacy unbound history, incomplete or uncertain tails, cross-model conversion and arbitrary imported transcripts remain unsupported for replay.
No normal CLI session persistence, task manager, server, GUI, hosted skills, billing path, retry/failover, compaction or import/export was added.
The implementation remains unstaged and uncommitted for owner review.
